segments.say: In one minute, two American cruisers lost their bows.
segments.caption: In one minute, two American cruisers lost their bows.

segments.say: Admiral Raizo Tanaka was running supplies to Guadalcanal with eight destroyers.
segments.caption: Admiral Raizo Tanaka was running supplies to Guadalcanal with eight destroyers.

segments.say: Waiting were five cruisers and six destroyers, with radar.
segments.caption: Waiting: five cruisers and six destroyers, with radar.

segments.say: He answered with torpedoes. Nearly four hundred Americans died.
segments.caption: He answered with torpedoes. Nearly 400 Americans died.

segments.say: Tanaka lost one destroyer. But his supplies never landed that night.
segments.caption: Tanaka lost one destroyer. But his supplies never landed that night.
